biography.plain_text: Sophie Desmarais is a Canadian philanthropist and daughter of financier Paul Desmarais, whose fortune she shared after his death. She has supported medical research and served as patron of the Jasmin Roy foundation's work against school bullying. Her memoir, Tout pour être heureuse, was published by Michel Lafon in 2021.

long_biography.plain_text:
Canadian philanthropist Sophie Desmarais lends Stéphane Tétreault the 1707 Stradivarius cello known as the Countess of Stainlein, Ex-Paganini. Her mother, Jacqueline, originally bought the instrument for the young cellist's use; Sophie continued the loan after Jacqueline's death. Tétreault has used it in his professional performing career.

She also founded a fund for the Université de Montréal Big Band. Its support enabled an international composition competition with separate student and open divisions. Entrants submitted new, unperformed works for large jazz ensemble. The prizes included concert premieres and recordings, pairing student composers with the university's Big Band and the open division with the Orchestre national de jazz de Montréal.
